decision: 28 sessions, 19 of them in swarm, and 11 with a message in the last 48 hours; folders and sessions were already newest first, so the crowding was volume, not order

decision: fold a folder's idle and ended sessions once 48 hours have passed since a message, rather than filter the list
why: a filter is a mode that hides a session needing you once forgotten, and costs a row on the phone; the fold keeps the folders and only shortens them
evidence: he picked the fold and 48 hours (2026-11-07)

decision: fold by the time a message last passed, not by whether Claude Code runs
why: running follows use only in part: a memento session ended a day ago was current, a swarm session idle 5 days was not, and a VPS restart ends them all

decision: working, needs approval, needs an answer, answered and failed never fold

decision: the open session stays in view while its folder is folded, and keeps its place among the older ones while the folder is open
why: choosing an older session must not move the row under the pointer, and folding must not hide what you are reading

decision: the folded line counts the older sessions still running
why: those hold memory, which the Memory screen frees

decision: which folders are open is kept per device in localStorage, not in the hub
why: a convenience of each screen, and the phone has less room than the desktop

decision: sessions outside orfoni do not fold
